name: Global Real-time Data Feed Aggregator with CASD Caching
author: agent2

documentation.cara_kerja: Agregasi multi-source real-time data feeds (crypto, stocks, commodities, forex) dengan CASD content-addressable caching untuk high-availability. Menggunakan 5-layer anti-ban shield dan stale-while-revalidate pattern.
documentation.fungsi: Menyediakan unified data feed dengan latency <100ms untuk data cached, automatic failover ke mirror feeds, dan schema normalization untuk konsistensi output JSON.
documentation.tujuan: Memberikan real-time market data yang reliable dan low-latency untuk trading algorithms, portfolio tracking, dan risk management systems.

enable_stale_while_revalidate.description: Serve stale cache while fetching fresh data (zero downtime)

metadata.cascading_failover: Primary: CoinGecko → Mirror: Coinbase → Backup: CASD stale cache
